column3: MT 8:5. Close to the Hebrew; “Accept the honor of saying” renders “Glory over me.”
MT 8:12. Close to the Hebrew; “lice” renders a word for gnats or small insects.
MT 8:17. Close to the Hebrew; “swarms of flies” renders “the swarm”; the kind of insect is not named.
MT 8:19. Close to the Hebrew; “a difference” renders a word meaning “ransom, redemption.”
